purpose: Keep candidate JavaScript out of the trusted node:test process while exercising the package root through a bounded JSON request/response boundary.

operations.inspect: Read the installed package manifest, resolve the safe ESM root export, import it, and return only package-shape metadata.
operations.strip: Call the default export once with one JSON-compatible value and return either the string result or a bounded exception type/message record.

in_scope_values: null, arrays, and plain JSON objects for TypeError checks
